description: Engineering Policy Engine — layered, context-aware, machine-verified invariants. Every check knows its environment and its layer. Layer 0 blocks everything; Layer 1 blocks releases; Layers 2-4 inform the scorecard.

invariants.name: No merge conflict markers
invariants.description: No real conflict markers (<<<<<<< / ======= / >>>>>>> on their own line) in tracked source files

invariants.name: Lockfile valid + in sync
invariants.description: package-lock.json parses and root package matches package.json

invariants.name: No secrets in tracked files
invariants.description: verify-secret-hygiene passes — no credentials in source

invariants.name: TypeScript >= 5 contract
invariants.description: No TypeScript 4.x or lower; verify:typescript is the gate

invariants.name: Pipeline integrity — 3 environments
invariants.description: dev/staging/prod all exist; skipped in CI without HEROKU_API_KEY

invariants.name: Redis quota headroom
invariants.description: Intervals at ~23% of 500k quota (heartbeat 5min, audit 15min, BRPOP 25s)

invariants.name: Server-runtime zero vulnerabilities
invariants.description: Server deps clean; Expo toolchain (xmldom) documented exception

invariants.name: Clean working tree
invariants.description: No uncommitted changes. NOT APPLICABLE on heroku-runtime (no git repo).

invariants.name: Active mission on roadmap
invariants.description: Roadmap has in_progress or planned phase

invariants.name: All environments serve healthy
invariants.description: dev/staging/prod /health endpoints return ok — product truth evidence

invariants.name: Knowledge is growing
invariants.description: Snippets + decisions + struggle-log trending upward — the platform got smarter
